review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Poem body, YAML heading metadata and printed source note remain provenance-distinct.

literary_domain.note: Naṟṟiṇai is treated as Akam work context; this is not inferred from the body.

speaker.note: Printed source note identifies தோழி and தலைவி roles; it remains context evidence, not poem-body text.

landscape_environment.note: Exact நீர் / உலகம் comparison retained without importing conventional landscape ecology.

flora.note: Exact தாமரை and சாந்து plant wording retained without modern botanical identification.

food_subsistence.note: Exact தேன் food/subsistence wording retained; the simile is not promoted into a production claim.

relationships.note: Steadfastness, non-separation, கேண்மை and நயந்த relationship language are source-explicit.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Fear of pallor and anticipated distress are retained as lived-experience language.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Speech, constancy and conduct evaluation are retained without universal ethical generalization.

body_health.note: Shoulder, forehead and pallor language is bodily description, not medical diagnosis.
